newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAYS HE WANTS OUT OF ROMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAYS HE WANTS OUT OF ROMA.

text.p: Swedish international striker Martin Dahlin said on Wednesday he had asked to be placed on the transfer list by Italian side Roma.
Dahlin told the Swedish news agency TT that club officials had agreed to his departure provided the price was right.
Dahlin, who has not played a full match for Roma since April, said Glasgow Rangers was one possible destination.
